source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.3.1 with Quick Checks 20.4-20.6 answered, printed pages 62-65.

blocks.text: Electrophile koi bhi ho, electrophilic aromatic substitution ka mechanism (reaction hone ka tareeqa) teen bare steps mein hota hai.

items: Electrophile banana (generation of electrophile): pehle step mein electrophile banta hai. Electrophile koi positive ion ya kisi polar molecule ka positive sira ho sakta hai. Aam taur par electrophile seedha mixture mein nahi dala ja sakta; munasib reagents dal kar yeh mixture ke andar hi (in situ) banaya jata hai.

Electrophile par hamla (electrophilic attack): doosre step mein benzene ke π electrons electrophile par hamla karte hain. Is se ring ke ek carbon aur electrophile ke darmiyan sigma bond banta hai. Ab ring mein sirf chaar π electrons reh jate hain aur positive charge paanch carbons par phail jata hai, is liye aromaticity toot jati hai. Naye sigma bond ki wajah se is intermediate (beech ki halat) ko sigma complex kehte hain.

Aromaticity wapas aana (restoration of aromaticity): teesre step mein sp³-hybridized carbon wala hydrogen ek counterion/conjugate base hata leta hai aur ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh C-H bond ke heterolytic cleavage (aisa tootna jis mein dono electrons ek hi taraf jayein) se hota hai: is bond ke electrons benzene ke π system mein wapas chale jate hain aur ring ki delocalisation bahal (restore) ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene, jis ki ring se E+ ki taraf mura teer (curly arrow); phir sigma complex: ring jis ke oopar wale carbon par H aur E, toota daira aur andar +, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer. Doosra teer, Rapid step, E wala benzene aur H+ deta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrophilic substitution ka aam mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Curly arrow (mura hua teer) electron pair ki harkat dikhata hai. Pehle ring ke π electrons E⁺ ke saath naya sigma bond banate hain; ring ka positive charge (+) baqi paanch carbons par phail jata hai, is liye circle toota hua dikhaya gaya hai. Phir tez (rapid) step mein C–H bond ke electrons wapas ring mein jate hain, H⁺ nikal jata hai aur aromatic ring wapas ban jati hai.
Arenes ki electrophilic substitution reactions ki misalein neeche hain.
Benzene ki halogenation
Benzene bromine aur chlorine se sirf Lewis acids ki mojoodgi mein react karta hai, kyun ke Lewis acids halogen se jur kar taqatwar electrophile banate hain.
Aam Lewis acids yeh hain: aluminium chloride (AlCl₃), iron chloride (FeCl₃) ya iron bromide (FeBr₃).
Yeh benzene ki bromination hai; is ke steps yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Benzene + Br2, teer ke oopar AlBr3 aur neeche ANHYDROUS (be-aab, paani ke baghair), se bromobenzene + HBr.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Br-Br, baen Br par delta+ aur daen par delta-; mura teer delta- wale bromine se AlBr3 ki taraf. Teer ke baad Br+ + [AlBr4]-.
blocks.caption: Br2 aur AlBr3 se electrophile Br+ ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 65 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Electrophile (Br⁺) ban jaye to aage wahi general mechanism chalta hai jo upar parha.

blocks.alt: Benzene, ring se Br+ ki taraf hara mura teer, se sigma complex jis ke aik carbon par Br aur H aur tootay daire mein +. [AlBr4]- se us H ki taraf mura teer, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer. Teer ke baad bromobenzene + HBr + AlBr3.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki bromination mein Br+ ka hamla aur proton ka nikalna (kitab ke PDF safha 65-66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pehle electrophile ring se jurta hai aur sigma complex banta hai; phir [AlBr₄]⁻ is se proton (H⁺) hata leta hai. Is se bromobenzene, HBr aur AlBr₃ (catalyst wapas) bante hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke sigma complex se proton “AlCl₄⁻” hatata hai; bromination mein yeh kaam [AlBr₄]⁻ karta hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein Br–Br ke partial charges “σ+ aur σ−” likhe hain; sahi nishan δ+ aur δ− hai. Wapas banne wala catalyst “[AlBr₃)” chhapa hai; sahi AlBr₃ hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle AlBr₃ (Lewis acid) Br–Br ko polar banata hai: AlBr₃ ki taraf wala Br δ− aur doosra δ+ ho jata hai. Bond toot kar Br⁺ (electrophile) aur [AlBr₄]⁻ bante hain. Phir ring Br⁺ par hamla karti hai, aur [AlBr₄]⁻ sigma complex se H⁺ le kar HBr aur AlBr₃ bana deta hai.
Isi tarah Cl⁺ banane ke liye FeCl₃ Lewis acid activator ke taur par use hota hai. Baqi mechanism bilkul benzene ki bromination jaisa hai.
Quick Check 20.4

blocks.prompt: a) AlCl₃ catalyst ke saath benzene aur chlorine ke reaction ka mechanism likhein.
blocks.explanation: Step 1: Cl₂ + AlCl₃ → Cl⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻. Step 2: Cl⁺ ring par hamla karta hai aur sigma complex banta hai. Step 3: [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ hatata hai; chlorobenzene + HCl bante hain aur AlCl₃ wapas mil jata hai.

blocks.text: Benzene ki nitration
Benzene par nitro group (–NO₂) concentrated HNO₃ aur concentrated H₂SO₄ ke mixture se lagaya jata hai. Mechanism ke steps yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Benzene + HNO3, teer ke oopar H2SO4, se nitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration (kitab ke PDF safha 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Concentrated nitric acid (HNO₃) aur concentrated sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) ke reaction se electrophile NO₂⁺ ion (nitronium ion) banta hai.
Benzene ring ka ek electron pair NO₂⁺ electrophile ko milta hai aur covalent bond banta hai; is se aromaticity khatam ho jati hai.
Jis carbon par NO₂ laga, us ka C–H bond toot'ta hai aur electrons wapas benzene ke π system mein chale jate hain; aromaticity wapas aa jati hai.

blocks.text: Mechanism

blocks.alt: Teen qadam. Electrophile ka banna: H2SO4 + HNO3 aur NO2+ + HSO4- + H2O ke darmiyan equilibrium (tawazun), NO2+ par electrophile ka nishan. Electrophile ka hamla: benzene ring se NO2+ ki taraf mura teer, aik carbon par H aur NO2 wala sigma complex; C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer, nitrobenzene + H+. Catalyst ki wapsi: HSO4- + H+ se H2SO4, catalyst ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki nitration ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 66 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sulphuric acid nitric acid se taqatwar acid hai: yeh HNO₃ ko proton deta hai, aur HNO₃ paani kho kar NO₂⁺ (nitronium ion, electrophile) ban jata hai. Ring NO₂⁺ par hamla karti hai, phir C–H bond toot kar ring wapas aromatic hoti hai aur H⁺ nikalta hai. Yeh H⁺ HSO₄⁻ se mil kar H₂SO₄ wapas bana deta hai, is liye H₂SO₄ catalyst hai.

Concentrated sulphuric acid catalyst ka kaam karta hai, is liye equations mein nahi likha jata. Zyada temperature par ring mein ek se zyada nitro groups lagne ka imkaan barh jata hai. 50°C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene + HNO3, teer ke oopar 50 darje C, se 1,3-dinitrobenzene + H2O.
blocks.caption: 1,3-dinitrobenzene ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Quick Check 20.5

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke nitration mein sulphuric acid aur nitric acid se electrophile kaise banta hai. In mein kaun acid ka aur kaun base ka kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: H₂SO₄ + HNO₃ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + HSO₄⁻ + H₂O. Sulphuric acid proton deta hai, is liye acid hai; nitric acid proton leta hai (phir paani kho kar NO₂⁺ banta hai), is liye yahan base ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.text: Friedel-Crafts alkylation aur acylation

Friedel-Crafts acylation mein Lewis acid catalyst ki mojoodgi mein benzene ring par acyl group lagta hai. Acyl group woh alkyl group hai jo carbonyl group se jura ho, R-C=O. Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein benzene ring par alkyl group lagta hai.

blocks.alt: Friedel-Crafts Alkylation: benzene + CH3CH2Cl, teer ke oopar heat (garmi) aur neeche AlCl3 catalyst, se ethylbenzene + HCl. Friedel-Crafts Acylation: benzene + CH3CH2COCl, garmi aur AlCl3 catalyst, se C(=O)CH2CH3 wali ring + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation aur acylation (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: a) Friedel-Crafts alkylation
Friedel-Crafts alkylation teen steps ke mechanism se hoti hai.

items: Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) alkyl halide se react karta hai aur carbocation (positive carbon wala ion) banta hai, jo electrophile hai.

blocks.alt: (CH3)3C-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid; Cl ke lone pair se AlCl3 ki taraf mura teer. Is se Cl(+)-AlCl3(-) jo abhi carbon se jura hai, aur C-Cl bond se Cl ki taraf mura teer. Products: 3 darje (tertiary) carbocation (CH3)3C+, electrophile - E+, aur [Cl-AlCl3]-.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein carbocation ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 67 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Aromatic ring ke π electrons carbocation par hamla karte hain aur intermediate ke taur par arenium ion banta hai. Carbon-carbon double bond tootne se arene ki aromaticity thori der ke liye khatam ho jati hai.

Intermediate se proton nikalne (deprotonation) par carbon-carbon double bond phir ban jata hai aur aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh proton HCl (hydrochloric acid) banata hai aur AlCl₃ catalyst wapas mil jata hai.

blocks.alt: Naya carbon-carbon bond: benzene se tertiary carbocation ki taraf mura teer (electrophile ka addition) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke carbon par H aur C(CH3)3 aur ring mein +. Proton ka nikalna, aromaticity wapas: [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf mura teer, aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer; teer ke neeche -AlCl3, product tert-butylbenzene + HCl.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts alkylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: AlCl₃ (Lewis acid) Cl ka lone pair le leta hai, C–Cl bond toot'ta hai aur (CH₃)₃C⁺ carbocation (electrophile) banta hai. Ring is carbocation par hamla kar ke naya C–C bond banati hai. 'Resonance structure' sigma complex ke kai structures mein se ek hai: + charge ring ke carbons par ghoomta hai. Aakhir mein [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ le kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas mil jata hai.
b) Friedel-Crafts acylation
Kitab ke mutabiq Friedel-Crafts acylation chaar steps ke mechanism se hoti hai; kitab neeche us ke teen hisse likhti hai.

items: Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) aur acyl halide react karte hain. Ek complex banta hai aur acyl halide ek halide ion kho deta hai; is se acylium ion banta hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-Cl, Lewis base, Cl par lone pairs, + AlCl3, Lewis acid, se complex R-C(=O)-Cl(+)-AlCl3(-), jis se acylium ion R-C(+)=O aur [Cl-AlCl3]- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation mein acylium ion ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Aromatic ring ke π electrons acylium ion (RCO⁺) par electrophilic hamla karte hain.

Intermediate complex se proton nikal jata hai aur ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai. Yeh proton chloride ion se mil kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ catalyst wapas mil jata hai. Is tarah Friedel-Crafts acylation se acyl benzene product milta hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene se R-C(+)=O ke carbon ki taraf mura teer (O par lone pair, aur C=O bond se O ki taraf mura teer) se sigma complex ki resonance structure, ring ke aik carbon par H aur C(=O)R aur ring mein +. [Cl-AlCl3]- se H ki taraf mura teer aur C-H bond se ring ki taraf mura teer; teer ke neeche -AlCl3, product aryl ketone, ring par C(=O)R.
blocks.caption: Friedel-Crafts acylation ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 68 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acylation mein electrophile acylium ion R–C⁺=O hai; O ka lone pair is ke + charge ko kuch had tak sambhalta hai. Ring is ke carbon par hamla karti hai, sigma complex banta hai, phir [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ le kar HCl banata hai aur aromatic ring wapas aati hai. Product aryl ketone hai; maslan R = CH₂CH₃ ho to C₆H₅COCH₂CH₃.
Quick Check 20.6

blocks.prompt: 1. AlBr₃ ki mojoodgi mein methyl benzene aur bromine ka reaction likhein.
blocks.explanation: Ring ki positions 2 aur 4 par substitution hoti hai (CH₃ ortho-para director): C₆H₅CH₃ + Br₂ → 2-bromomethylbenzene aur 4-bromomethylbenzene (mixture) + HBr.

blocks.prompt: 2. Bromine ki benzene aur phenol ke saath reactivity mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono electrophilic substitution hain. Benzene ko liquid bromine aur Lewis acid catalyst (FeBr₃ ya AlBr₃) chahiye; bromobenzene + HBr bante hain. Phenol ka OH group ring ko bohat active karta hai, is liye bromine water room temperature par baghair catalyst react karta hai aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate + 3HBr banta hai.

blocks.prompt: 3. Bromine ki benzene aur ethyl benzene ke saath reactivity mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Andhere mein Lewis acid catalyst ke saath dono ring par substitution karte hain: benzene bromobenzene deta hai; ethyl benzene tezi se react karta hai (ethyl group ring ko active karta hai) aur 2- aur 4-bromoethylbenzene deta hai. UV roshni mein baghair catalyst ethyl benzene ki side chain par free radical substitution hoti hai, zyada tar ring ke saath wale CH₂ par, aur (1-bromoethyl)benzene banta hai; benzene ka ring aise substitute nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: 4. Friedel-Crafts reaction se 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene aur methyl benzene mein se kaun aasani se banta hai? Carbocation ki stability se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: 1,1-dimethylethylbenzene (tert-butylbenzene). Is ka electrophile tertiary carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺ hai, jo teen alkyl groups ki wajah se stable hai; methyl benzene ke liye bohat unstable methyl cation CH₃⁺ chahiye.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Teen steps: electrophile banna, ring ka hamla (sigma complex), H⁺ nikalna aur aromaticity wapas.
Halogenation: Br₂/AlBr₃ (ya Cl₂/FeCl₃); nitration: HNO₃ + H₂SO₄ se NO₂⁺; Friedel-Crafts: AlCl₃ se R⁺ ya RCO⁺.
Lewis acid ya H₂SO₄ aakhir mein wapas mil jata hai: yeh catalyst hai.
